Thank you, Madhavi ma’am, Dharmesh sir, Harsh sir, and the whole CMA team—you’ve helped Nurvi grow in confidence and curiosity.

featured_reviews.review_text:
​My son Aoshnar Vakshoor attends the marine lines branch. Despite having full parental rights and paid the full tuition fees myself, this school chose to support a letter from the mother and has blocked me from accessing any information about my son's progress or well-being. They made this decision without requesting any official court document or legal proof—just based on a written request.
​This is a massive breach of trust and shows a shocking lack of awareness about parental rights.
​To make matters worse, when I called the Head Office to resolve this serious issue, the person I spoke with actually hung up on me and then refused to answer my subsequent calls.
​It's heartbreaking to be arbitrarily shut out of my child's life by his school, and their customer service response was appalling. Avoid this school if you are a co-parent.

featured_reviews.name: Yukta Sasne
featured_reviews.review_text: Very nice school. Their method of teaching is so enjoyable that kids learn through playing various games, puzzles etc. My kid enjoyed the school so much that she never wanted a holiday. So many indoor activities, outside visits, parents participation in kids activities makes it more worthy. Teachers are very nice, intelligent and cooperative. You can see all round development in your kid, day by day. I felt so lucky and thankful to this school as I got chance to admit my kid here. Thank you so much Chip n Dale team and all the best for your future.

featured_reviews.name: Kajal Gaikwad
featured_reviews.review_text: We our very happy with chip and Dale school. Teachers are incredibly caring and patient and makes learning fun and engaging. We highly recommend this school for any parent who are looking for  quality early childhood education program..

featured_reviews.name: Sandeep Mehra
featured_reviews.review_text: Very happy with the way children learn to mingle with each other via group activities and learn to share things. A fun way of education.

featured_reviews.name: vijay patil
featured_reviews.review_text: Thank u Chip and Dale for giving kids education with free environment.such caring and loving teacher are there.even today Rajvardhan miss his old school.thanks chip n dell..

featured_reviews.name: Dhananjay Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text: This is the best pre-school in South Mumbai where teachers take extreme care of kids. My daughter enjoyed every moment of her time in this school, and she still misses her Dolly Teacher, Kajal teacher and Tasneem teacher. The school atmosphere is very warm & it creates a personal bond of love with every kid. This is 101% percent recommended pre-school according to me. My daughter had learned good values and manners along with the study.
